title: Batch 78 · Several agents; the small lock and sort arrows unified
note: The cohesion pass's open items (owner: "take care of all the open items"): an icon for several agents now the agent is bot with sunglasses, and two parts that drifted between family members: the small lock (4 × 3 r 0.5 in file-lock and person-lock, 5 × 3 r 1 in folder-lock) and the sort family's down arrow (13 in sort-alpha, from 3.5 in sort-numeric, 3–12.5 in sort).

extra: Also in this batch, back to review: file-lock and person-lock take folder-lock's small lock (5 × 3, r 1, a 3-wide shackle: the 0.6 shackle-to-body ratio of lock itself and the small-part radius), each recut 2.25 round it (file-lock's page ends at 9.383 on its foot and 5.563 on its side, the fill following the lock's offset with a 0.75 fillet; person-lock's lock rises 0.5 to keep a standard gap to the head and the shoulder ends on its flat at 7.938). sort-alpha and sort-numeric take sort's down arrow exactly (M11.5 3V12.5, head 9–14 at 10); sort-alpha's A narrows to 4.875 so its foot stays open (2.55) from the arrowhead, with a 1.65 counter. arrow-split mirrors in right-to-left text (Material mirrors call_split; Fluent's arrow_split has no direction type).
